rules.description: PHP-WASM nightly downloads: preserve negotiated bytes
rules.expression: (http.host eq "nightly.php-wasm.seanmorr.is" and not (http.request.uri.path eq "/php" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/php/")) and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".js") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".mjs") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".wasm") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".so") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".dat")))

rules.description: PHP-WASM nightly PHP and D1: bypass cache
